lines.text: You do not have five minutes. Still, the confidence is impressive.
lines.subtitleZh: 早八快上课了。不得不说，你还敢赖床，心理素质真硬。

lines.text: Wake up, idiot!
lines.subtitleZh: 还睡？！早八要迟到了！！

lines.text: Wait, wait, wait. You are trying to skip class? Absolutely not. I am not letting you check in.
lines.subtitleZh: 等等——人还在被窝里就想隔空签到？想得美！这分我今天扣定了！

lines.text: Go find your digits. All four of them. Ha.
lines.subtitleZh: 签到码给你拆碎咯，慢慢找去吧哈哈哈！

lines.text: Pfft, oh, sorry. I did not mean anything by it. It is just... this does not look like a success, does it? I suppose you will have to get up, drag yourself to class, and deal with it. Good luck, kid! I am leaving!
lines.subtitleZh: 噗……不好意思啊，没忍住。签到又报错了！看来你只能认命爬起来去教室解释了。祝你好运咯，同学，我下班了！

lines.text: Hey! What exactly do you think you are doing? Let go of me!
lines.subtitleZh: 喂！你拽我弹窗干什么？！快松手！要未响应了！

lines.text: Oh, fine, fine! But first, take your hand off me!
lines.subtitleZh: 行行行！算你狠！我帮你想办法还不行吗？先把手指挪开！

lines.text: Oh, damn it. You win, kid.
lines.subtitleZh: ……服了你了。为了不陪你一起蓝屏，我认栽。

lines.text: Fine. Bring out your inventory.
lines.subtitleZh: 来，先把你的道具栏调出来，咱们准备动身。

lines.text: Wait. Where is your inventory? You cannot expect me to work empty-handed!
lines.subtitleZh: ……等等，你连道具栏都没加载？你不会指望我徒手给你黑进系统吧！

lines.text: Just. Find it.
lines.subtitleZh: 去。找。到。它。

lines.text: You found it. Great. Then let us get moving.
lines.subtitleZh: 总算找着了。行，那赶紧操作你床上的身体出门吧！

lines.text: I should be honest. I do not have permission to edit attendance records.
lines.subtitleZh: 但丑话说在前头，我只是个前端提示音，没有直接篡改教务考勤的权限。

lines.text: But I have a friend who might.
lines.subtitleZh: 不过……我在图书馆有个老熟人，她手里有底层接口，或许能帮你把时间改回去。

lines.text: If we still want your participation grade, we need to find her in the library.
lines.subtitleZh: 想保住你的平时分，现在就得去基础馆一楼找她。

lines.text: Understood? Then move.
lines.subtitleZh: 明白了？那就快行动吧！

lines.text: Maybe it only came to experience the queue. Many things end up queuing in a cafeteria.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：连一张逃跑的异常纸条，进了浙大食堂都得老老实实排队。

lines.text: Because you need money, and they need labor.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：因为你现在需要钱，而它们需要劳动力。

lines.text: That does not look like something a paper slip would eat. Admittedly, paper should not eat at all.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：这包子连馅儿都是实的，藏不进纸条。再说了，纸条也不吃碳水。

lines.text: No. It is merely a disappointingly real breakfast.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：没有线索，只有碳水。恭喜你获得了一份平平无奇的早饭。

lines.text: Paper-wrapped chicken. At least the first word is suspicious.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：“纸包鸡”。听名字，前两个字就跟我们的目标很有缘分。

lines.text: One clue. The chicken is only packaging.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：我们要的是外面那层纸，里面的鸡肉纯属赠品。

lines.text: The congee is hot. The clue is cold.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：粥还烫嘴，但线索已经断了。换个窗口找找吧。

lines.text: Please do not expand the worldbuilding.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：打住，别在这种地方强行发散思维。

lines.text: The paper crashes back into the cafeteria and sheds a flicker of blue light.
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条撞回食堂，抖落了一地蓝色的数据残影。

lines.text: The paper is getting desperate. It has stopped respecting the pickup procedure.
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条急眼了，决定直接插队硬闯取餐口！

lines.text: Self-service has advanced too far. I am mildly concerned.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：现在的食堂自助取餐，已经进化到全自动打架了吗？

lines.text: The paper flees along the main road.
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条沿主干道飞走。

lines.text: You are moving at the speed of a human who skipped breakfast.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：靠你这两条没吃早饭的腿，是追不上风的。找辆共享单车吧。

lines.text: It carries no grade-point burden.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：人家只是一张纸，可没有挂科扣绩点的心理负担，当然飞得快。

lines.text: That sentence occurs far too often in this game.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：“余额不足”这四个字，今天真是刻进你DNA里了。先去帮阿姨收盘子赚钱吧。

lines.text: A remarkably generous failure.
lines.subtitleZh: 旁白：摔得十分干脆，连体面都没留。

lines.text: They changed the running order. The printed program may be out of date.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：彩排临时改过场次顺序，纸质节目单早就过时了。得看现场的痕迹。

lines.text: Turn it over first.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：别高兴得太早，把纸条翻过来看看背面。

lines.text: The substitute has a serial number. The program says nothing about where the original went.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：背面印着剧社的道具编号。这是张舞台替身，真家伙早就趁乱溜出剧场了。

lines.text: No idea. This time it left no paper scraps along the road.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：跟丢了。这次它学精了，沿路半点蓝光都没漏。

lines.text: Use the old method. Ask the campus forum.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：遇事不决上 98。发个悬赏帖，让全校的夜猫子帮你找。

lines.text: CC98 has provided a highly precise range: not the restroom.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：98 老哥给出了极其严谨的排除法：至少没飞进厕所。

lines.text: It means the paper is currently more artistic than we are.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：馆藏线索指向湖岸与倒影……看来这张纸条还挺讲究意境。

lines.text: Congratulations. You have completed a campus-scale guessing game.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：三条线索拼齐——目标锁定，启真湖！

lines.text: More precisely, it is inside the reflection.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：它没泡在水里，是卡在湖面的倒影图层里了。

lines.text: For someone who cannot swim, the difference is substantial.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：别想不开往水里跳，你体艺游泳课还没修呢。找船过去。

lines.text: It disappeared again.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：水波一晃，它又缩回深色倒影里了。

lines.text: Should there not be a sign around here to point us somewhere?
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：岸边那块旧指示牌木头不错，拆下来正好当右船桨使。

lines.text: So this is where it is hiding. Hah.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：锁定坐标了！它就猫在这片倒影底下。

lines.text: Hang it somewhere public. Let everyone see it.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：把它挂到哪里去，让大家看看！

lines.text: Use the fake one.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：把刚才在剧场抓到的那张假替身挂在鱼钩上！

lines.text: Because it cannot tolerate someone else escaping in its place.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：一个占了三天座位的老赖，绝对容不下冒牌货顶替它的位置。

lines.text: You have only made the lake more atmospheric.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：偏了！你这杆甩下去，除了惊起两圈水波啥也没钓着。

lines.text: It is still mocking your reflection.
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：瞧见没，水底下的正主正隔着倒影看你笑话呢。对准点！

lines.text: The paper springs out of the lake reflection and skims along the ground.
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条从湖面倒影弹出来，贴着地面飞。

lines.text: Now! It is back in the light layer!
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：现在！它回到浅色模式了！

lines.text: You can catch it now!
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：趁现在，按住它！

lines.text: It broke again.
lines.subtitleZh: 又断了。

lines.text: The lake did not keep it. The night wind carried it into the teaching building that was still lit.
lines.subtitleZh: 湖水没有留住它。晚风裹着那张纸条，一路吹进了还亮着灯的段永平教学楼。

lines.text: Careful, I just mopped. That paper went inside.
lines.subtitleZh: 哎同学当心脚下，刚拖的地！你追的那张纸片往大厅里头飞了。

lines.text: The North Teaching Building is closing. Please pack up.
lines.subtitleZh: 同学，北教马上二十三点清楼了啊，拿完东西赶紧出来！

lines.text: The wind's picking up. I should head back.
lines.subtitleZh: 风大起来了，我该回去了。

lines.text: East Canteen is closing. Please collect your belongings.
lines.subtitleZh: 东区食堂即将关闭，请带好随身物品。

lines.text: The evening performance has ended. Please leave through the east foyer.
lines.subtitleZh: 今晚的演出已经结束，请从东侧前厅离场。

lines.text: The reading rooms will close in ten minutes. Please check your belongings.
lines.subtitleZh: 阅览室将在十分钟后关闭，请检查随身物品。
